evidence.quote: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret. These may be sent either in the request body or in the headers PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET.
Get started with test credentials and life-like data.
create an account on the Plaid Dashboard. Once you've completed the signup process and acknowledged our terms, we'll provide a live client_id and secret via the Dashboard.

result.notes: Core Plaid API auth is client_id/secret (api_key style), sent via headers PLAID-CLIENT-ID/PLAID-SECRET or request body; not OAuth2/bearer for developer access (Plaid Link uses OAuth for end-user bank login, which is a separate concern from developer API auth). Free self-serve Sandbox account obtainable via Dashboard signup with no sales contact required; Production access requires additional verification/compliance review per Plaid policy but is still self-serve initiated. MCP: no official vendor-published MCP server page could be confirmed (docs/mcp and docs/ai-tools paths 404'd); registry and third-party (Composio) list a community/wrapped MCP server plus several community GitHub MCP repos (e.g. plaid/ai-coding-toolkit, 304techmaven/plaid-mcp-server), so classified as community pending direct confirmation.
result.one_liner: Plaid is a fintech API platform that lets developers securely connect apps to users' bank accounts for data, payments, and identity verification.
